''See also: [[Spear of Tharlos Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The Spear of Tharlos, the Formless Legion{{!}}Tharlos is an ancient, legendary artifact forged during the Elder Days by one of the Emperor's companions. It was crafted from the remains of Tharlos, the Formless Legion{{!}}Tharlos, a member of the Formless [[Legion]] and a [[Great Elder]] of Chaos. The weapon is composed of a single piece of yellowed bone, featuring a straight shaft that terminates in a sharp, [[spade]]-like blade. Despite its physical dimensions—standing approximately six feet tall when fully extended—the spear possesses the supernatural ability to compress itself into a small size, allowing it to be stored within a coat pocket. Currently soulbound to Bliss of the Blackwatch{{!}}Bliss, the Blackwatch Guild Head{{!}}Head of the Blackwatch, the spear is a sentient and highly volatile entity. It possesses its own consciousness and desires, often attempting to influence Bliss of the Blackwatch{{!}}Bliss's mind with visions of chaotic transformation or expressing restless emotions like laughter and greed. The spear's primary intent is to facilitate constant change, a drive that can manifest as the weapon twisting mid-air to defy physics, shapeshifting into various forms such as a muskrat or a turtle, or causing the surrounding environment to ripple and transform. In combat, it is an exceptionally powerful tool capable of sweeping away [[dead matter]], striking with the force of thunder, and exerting a heavy, mountain-like [[aura]] that can pressure the minds of those nearby. Bliss of the Blackwatch{{!}}Bliss must occasionally feed the weapon to maintain its calm and prevent it from becoming too difficult to control.}}

== Of Kings and Killers ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|Crafted by the [[Regents]] from a bone harvested from the [[Great Elder]] of Chaos, the Spear of Tharlos, the Formless Legion{{!}}Tharlos possesses unsettlingly lifelike qualities, including a rhythmic throbbing similar to a heartbeat. The artifact once held [[Calder]] at his throat upon his awakening, driven by an internal intent that seeks constant change. To manage this volatility, Bliss of the Blackwatch{{!}}Bliss utilizes an [[Intent]]-sealing harness to restrain the weapon, which also maintains the ability to neutralize lethal poisons. Ultimately, the Spear underwent a transformation and turned into a muskrat.}}

<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">7</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The [[Spear of Tharlos]] was made by the [[Regents]] from a bone taken from the [[Great Elder]] of Chaos.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c7">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 7</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The [[Spear of Tharlos]] exhibits life-like qualities such as throbbing like a heart.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c7" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The [[Spear of Tharlos]] is at [[Calder]]'s throat when he wakes.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c11">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 11</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The [[Spear of Tharlos]]' [[Intent]] wants things to change constantly.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c13">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 13</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|Bliss of the Blackwatch{{!}}Bliss keeps the [[Spear of Tharlos]] in an [[Intent]]-sealing harness.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c13" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The [[Spear of Tharlos]] can neutralize lethal [[poison]].<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c13" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The [[Spear of Tharlos]] turned into a muskrat.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c23">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 23</ref>}}</li>
